cells.gaps: The roaming finding covers the operators' tariffs; no other cross-border use of a shared text is reported.
cells.note: Ratified the Malabo Convention in 2020, and Decree-Law 9/2021 adopts ECOWAS Directive C/DIR. 1/08/11 into the cybersecurity regime. ECOWAS found Cape Verde operators' roaming tariffs in line with its roaming regulation in November 2024, inside three years.
